title: Clarity Act DEAD? XRP Reprice Coming Anyway + Ripple Heads To LAS VEGAS
description:
In this video, the host breaks down the latest XRP developments, focusing on the potential for a major repricing of the token amid growing institutional adoption and regulatory shifts. He analyzes whether the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act is effectively stalled or "dead" in its current form due to Senate delays, bank lobbying, and shifting timelines (with some senators now targeting end-of-May markup), while noting that XRP remains well-positioned even without immediate passage thanks to on-chain utilities and real-world use cases. The discussion then shifts to Ripple's upcoming high-profile event in Las Vegas starting April 30, hyping it as a major community and industry gathering that could spark further momentum, alongside broader market signals pointing to bullish catalysts for XRP in the near term. Overall, the tone is optimistic for long-term holders despite short-term legislative uncertainty.
